shellCommands.command: pwd && ls -la && git status --short && cat package.json 2>/dev/null | head -60; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100

for f in src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; echo; done; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules | wc -l

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && cat package.json | grep -E '"version"|"main"|"types"' ; ls; ls build 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rl "Pagination\|Checkbox" --include=*.d.ts . | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && cat components/index.d.ts | tr ',' '\n' | head -150; echo; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules | grep -i -E "table|gravity"; cat components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts; cat components/Pagination/Pagination.d.ts; cat components/Pagination/types.d.ts | head -80
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && ls Table; cat Table/index.d.ts; cat Table/Table.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cat Table/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -150

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc && ls; cat index.d.ts; for f in withTableSorting withTableSelection; do echo "== $f"; cat $f/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null || cat $f.d.ts; done; ls withTableSorting withTableSelection 2>/dev/null
cat withTableSelection/withTableSelection.d.ts withTableSorting/withTableSorting.d.ts; echo ====; cat withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js | head -150
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting && cat withTableSorting.js | head -200; ls SortIndicator

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table && grep -n "static getRowId" -A 12 Table.js; grep -n "getRowDescriptor" Table.js | head; cat hoc/withTableSorting/SortIndicator/SortIndicator.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/Pagination.js | head -60
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -40
(which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules | grep -i -E "^playwright|puppeteer|jsdom|testing-library") ; echo "exit $?"
